meta.parties: De Silva Et Al. v. De Silva

rules.statement: The cause of action to recover a legacy accrues to the legatee on the death of the testator, and prescription begins to run from that date.
rules.supporting_quote: "The correct view seems to be that taken by the trial Judge, and contended for by the respondent, namely, that a cause of action to obtain his legacy accrues to a legatee on the death of the testator."
